newsitem.title: USA: Worldtex sees Q1 earnings below expectations.
newsitem.headline: Worldtex sees Q1 earnings below expectations.

text.p: Worldtex Inc said Thursday that earnings for the first quarter would be below expectations due to weakness of the French franc against the dollar.
Results for the quarter are expected to be flat with those of a year ago, said the company.
Worldtex makes covered elastic yarn used in the manufacture of high-end fashion apparel, sweaters, pantyhose, socks and athletic wear.
"The weakness in the French franc versus the U.S. dollar is the major reason for the earnings short-fall," said Barry Setzer, president and chief executive.
The company's prior estimate of 1997 earnings of $0.90 a share is unlikely to be achieved if the weakness in the franc continues, he added.
He said the company's French subsidiary also experienced some softness in sales but expects the situation to be short-term.
